name: Weighted Weft
definingDecision: Choose binary squares so row totals use column positions as weights and column totals use row positions as weights.
differentiator: Each square is a binary subset inclusion and its weight depends on its coordinate. No digit assignment or uniqueness, no run ordering, no XOR parity repair or minimum-change budget.
controls: Tap square to cycle filled / empty / unknown; row and column weighted sums update live.
finiteDesign: Three escalating studies; every study must satisfy the actual validator. Preserve the finite journey and score each completion.

validation: Every row weighted sum and every column weighted sum matches after all squares are assigned.
generationLevelStrategy: Generate nonuniform binary patterns and derive weighted marginals; accept every satisfying alternate pattern. Grow4→5→6 and cap endless at6.
